title: State changes allowed behaviour
summary: State describes the current condition of an object. Different states can allow different actions.
introduction: State describes the current condition of an object. Different states can allow different actions. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: State changes allowed behaviour

blocks.text: The result is open. The rule allows a closed door to open.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a closeDoor function that works only when open.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: List the allowed state changes instead of accepting every action in every state.
